passage: The school's new writing program has three goals for its first year, according to the principal. It aims to improve students' essay writing, ______ and strengthen their research skills.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The list follows "aims to": improve…, ___, and strengthen….
Parallel structure requires the same verb form: "build."
"Building," "to have built" and "their confidence built" break the pattern.
key: Items in a series must share the same grammatical form.
source: SAT AIS original item, written to the College Board Digital SAT content specifications
